$Comment: Applies flock leash behavior as an overlay. Uses FlockFollower* params for all roles; baby roles should override those params directly.

LeashEnabled.Description: Whether follower-to-leader leash behavior is enabled.

FlockFollowerWanderRadius.Description: How far followers are allowed to drift from their flock leader.

FlockFollowerStopDistance.Description: How close followers stop when moving back toward their leader.

FlockFollowerRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed used by leash seek behavior.

FlockFollowDurationRange.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Leash-only mode does not use timed follow windows.

BabyDirectFollowEnabled.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Not used by leash-only mode.

BabyDirectFollowRadius.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Not used by leash-only mode.

BabyDirectFollowStopDistance.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Not used by leash-only mode.

BabyDirectFollowRelativeSpeed.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Not used by leash-only mode.

BabyDirectFollowDurationRange.Description: Deprecated compatibility field. Not used by leash-only mode.

Instructions.$Comment: Leash profile using role/template FlockFollower* values.
